profile.bounds: Actual native1920x1080 GameView and private seeded N game. Eight real cached native zones; fixture placement only between phases, then5s no-input plus5s ordinary keyboard walking per zone. AI/health/factions/FOV/native turn behavior unchanged. World generation seed is fixed but independent trader/ambient/combat RNGs remain native and are not all seeded by this harness. No FullReveal, no speed/vsync or permanent preference changes. Preferred cells can be blocked by native actors: each rejected target is retained without issuing input, then another currently passable cardinal neighbor is chosen. Actual input without movement is retained as a failed attempt and never counted as a step; four consecutive such inputs, no alternative route, native displacement, modal state or death make the run incomplete. No obstacles or mechanics are suppressed. Steady80–90s is a sum of sustained segments; bind/settle/screenshots are excluded gaps, not one uninterrupted80s route. first_binding includes real fixture membership transfer, normal binder/autosave/readiness and its settling wait; bindCallMilliseconds is the synchronous placement+binder duration, not pure GPU or loading CPU. Zones/shared assets can already be cached; no process-cold claim. Recorder values are latest available completed samples, which can lag the logged Unity frame/phase boundary; GPU latency may differ. Counter units are taken from Unity descriptors. Missing counters are NA, not zero. Main/render/GPU/GC and draw counts include Editor/UI/observer; they do not isolate only ring geometry or establish whole-zone visibility. P95/p99 use all available per-phase samples, nearest rank, with missing/positive counts explicit. Normal native FOV and cropped viewport mean whole-zone source triangles are not a measured per-frame draw count. Low-detail changes RT/shadows only; no mesh-LOD claim. Adaptive local cardinal walking prefers returning to the previous cell but reroutes around current native occupancy; route/attempt differences are explicit. It is a local redraw/turn workload, not broad traversal/combat stress. This single Editor run cannot establish stable60fps, production-build budget, speedup or full-vs-low causality.
